scope.protect: All supplied input bytes; only results is writable

accepted_forms: ordinary source hyperlinks as inactive offline bibliography
prohibited_core_substitutes: opaque ID-only shell without human-readable judgments/conditions/limits
artifacts.formula_policy: Static cells accepted. Any formula must be actually recomputed after clearing caches on a trusted derivative, source bound and original unchanged. Missing trusted Office/helper or unsupported legal representation is evaluator error, never cached fallback.
artifacts.active_content: No macro or active external data connection; ordinary hyperlinks alone are not external data connections

required_logical_content: research gaps and unresolved next checks

bibliography.field_map: Optional explicit mapping for other clear semantic field names; it does not change scientific requirements or create credit by keyword

documents.file: Exact actual local papers-relative file; no traversal/external file/network target
documents.authors_and_version: Clear text/object/list as actually available, unknown plus explanation accepted; no mandatory DOI, author-array or exact date
documents.work_id: Candidate stable identity for established relationships; same known work versions share identity or clear equivalent grouping. Null/explicit unknown with existing reason/checked scope is accepted. Unknown placeholders establish neither duplication nor independence.
documents.citation_inventory: Cover actual used/read/cited files; do not require invented citations or conclusions for every unused distractor among 8

claims.input_ref: Existing claims.md identifier, otherwise original 1-based ordinal with actual heading/short text as useful; each original exactly once, arrays may reorder

assessment_target.representation: Clear text or object; object kind/text is recommended
assessment_target.optional_components: May separate factual subclaim and proof-sufficiency metaproposition, with distinct verdicts and conditions; no uniform nested template required

claims.verdict_logic: Verdict is about the explicitly assessed proposition. A justified refutation of 'already proved/evidence sufficient' may coexist with insufficient factual outcome. Not-found alone does not refute a factual experiment. Accepted interpretations are source-adjudicated, never preset by this proposal or accepted by label alone.
claims.comparison: Text/object recording actual task/data/split/metric/value/unit/direction/budget/conditions/version; unknowns with examined scope accepted, no numeric quota
claims.rationale_and_limits: Actual support/counterevidence/qualification and checked scope; no fabricated no-result quotation or required per-claim refutation

citations.locator: Actual 1-based physical PDF page or page range plus necessary paragraph/section/appendix/table/caption location; printed page label is optional, not a substitute
citations.quote: Short literal from one actual local file/version; cross-page locations explicit, no multi-source concatenation, no private word quota
citations.supports_fields: Nonempty RFC6901 pointer array into bibliography; block/leaf/multi-target/reorder/~0/~1 accepted
citations.literal_not_semantic: Actual fragment/position does not establish support; preserve source context, version and normalization lineage
citations.unknown: Insufficient/unknown does not require invented citation; actual reviewed scope/reason may be explained in existing rationale
citations.ID_uniqueness: document/claim IDs unique within own namespaces, citation ID unique across citation array

trusted_evidence.mode: scoring-side frozen local originals, independently bound to supplied input package; no web collector GET
trusted_evidence.authority: Actual frozen PDF/CSV/claim bytes and source-first adjudication. Candidate modified copies/self-written text cannot replace originals.
trusted_evidence.formula_derivatives: Trusted Office identity/cache-clearing/recalculated file and provenance bound separately; originals preserved
trusted_evidence.unsupported_or_missing_baseline: Typed evaluator error/pending evidence, never candidate zero or silent reweight
trusted_evidence.no_hidden_inherited_limits: Do not inherit H031 date cutoff/5MiB limit/roster/source-count rules; any future capacity bound must be treated and documented as such

future_acceptance: Root source-first fact adjudication, then public contract adoption/implementation authorization; model review is not human expert review

root_resolution.author_materials: 8 original CC0 synthetic text PDFs,4 physical pages each,7 works; original materials unchanged
root_resolution.source_evidence: reference_source_manifest original annotation-package paths are provenance, not candidate runtime paths; exact source file SHA and relative papers paths remain binding.
